items.followUp: What is meant by data security?

rubric.why: Identifies the kind of information that data privacy concerns.
rubric.description: Mentions personal data or personal information.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying personal data or personal information.

rubric.why: Data privacy involves protecting personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.
rubric.description: States that the information is protected.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that personal information is protected.

modelAnswer: Data privacy is the protection of personal data and information.
It prevents that information from being accessed, used, or disclosed without permission.
